The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
